notes.title: Dark Life Excalibur: Blood, Action, Adrenaline and Bestiality.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44331618/fe27c55ccfd7f25eae15032b0e8c7cb5da756264.png

Add Dark Life Excalibur to your Wishlist!

Dark Life: Excalibur is a fantasy action adventure that tells the story of Aron, a human linked to the most famous and legendary sword of all time: Excalibur. 

Aron must find peace through his family's vengeance and to do so he must discover why York, the lord of the giants, destroyed everything he fought for. To confront the beings that pursue him, he must forge a sword capable of killing gods, unaware that it would become the most legendary sword of all time, but also the one that has shed the most blood.

[previewyoutube=2vPl_Bm8Vbk;full][/previewyoutube]

In the world of Dark Life: Excalibur, bestiality is a power that accumulates in the hearts of the beings that inhabit it. By killing enemies, you can accumulate bestiality in the form of fragments, which can be used to buy upgrades, level up and improve parts of your Excalibur sword to build your own structure.

Each area will have a final boss and mini bosses that are part of the story. Finishing them off is a necessary challenge to accomplish your goal. You will encounter puzzles as well as frantic combat and sometimes you will be overwhelmed by the difficulty of certain enemies.

Don't forget to add it to your Wishlist on PS5 and Steam!
